facts.fact: Law 164/AN/22/8ème L of 27 July 2022 on the digital economy ministry cites Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L on identification of natural persons and the NNI among its legal bases.
facts.system: Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L (2019, national identification number and national register of persons)

facts.fact: The same law cites Decree n° 2020-146/PR/MI on terms of access, use and communication of the RNPP (decree date not given; year from its number).
facts.system: Décret n° 2020-146/PR/MI (access to and use of the RNPP), under Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L

note: Ministry organisation law, not an identity law; facts only from its citations.
